ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 3:2 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central and basal fluke regions to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at the lateral lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-intensity contiguous zones at the lateral extremities. The left zone contains low-intensity stochastic mottling and focal points. The right zone is characterized by high-intensity pixels segmented by parallel, low-intensity linear bands. The central fluke body is a contiguous low-intensity region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude along both trailing edges. A significant, high-amplitude jagged indentation is present on the medial-lateral portion of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical curvature; the trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the median notch, while the outer lateral tips show a slightly convex trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 4-6 localized, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters situated within the high-intensity field of the left lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary detection of 5+ parallel, dark, diagonal linear streaks on the right lobe tip. A single, distinct, non-parallel linear disruption is visible traversing the high-intensity field of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive parallel rake marks on the ventral surface of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'comb' pattern on the right lateral tip formed by the intersection of high-intensity surface pixels and parallel low-intensity linear scarring.
